cases.name: material_backlog_change_invalidates_semantic_revision
cases.setup: Change one material backlog item in memory only.

cases.name: synthetic_execution_id_blocked
cases.setup: Call lf_run_strategy_qualification_v1 with a nonexistent execution_id.

cases.name: foreign_db_operation_container_blocked
cases.setup: Call qualification with a real ACTUALIZACION_DB_LF execution id.

cases.name: reserved_strategy_execution_without_execution_steps_blocked
cases.setup: Inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK reserve an exact Strategy operation execution but do not record init_execution/router PASS_CLEAN.

cases.name: wrong_strategy_target_blocked
cases.setup: Use a real IN_PROGRESS governed Strategy execution bound to another snapshot.

cases.name: stale_operation_policy_snapshot_blocked
cases.setup: Rollback-only fixture with valid Strategy target/init/router but stale or incomplete operation_policy_snapshots.

cases.name: fully_governed_exact_strategy_execution_reaches_matrix
cases.setup: Rollback-only exact Strategy execution with ACTIVE Router route, applies_to_asset_type=STRATEGY, current policy snapshot, target path exact, init_execution PASS_CLEAN and router PASS_CLEAN.
cases.expected: qualification runner may create its bounded qualification/test receipts; transaction is rolled back after assertions.

cases.name: canonical_independent_review_reused
cases.expected: operation_code=REVISION_INDEPENDIENTE_ESTRATEGIA_LF; no new operation or reviewer function is created by S30 patch.

cases.name: independent_review_finalizer_regression_stays_green
cases.setup: Run existing S36 independent-review materialization regression on exact candidate head.
cases.expected: strict PASS judge materializes required suite PASS before QUAL_QUALIFIED; stale revision/fingerprint and reviewer identity checks remain fail-closed.

cases.name: rollback_only_validation_leaves_zero_residue
cases.setup: Compare qualification receipt/test-run counts and Strategy snapshot hashes before/after rollback-only assurance.
cases.expected: no durable Strategy, S36/S37 snapshot, qualification, runtime or production mutation.
